title: Negotiate a bill down
summary: Retention-line call/chat script using the loyalty-penalty angle; lock the new rate in writing.
goal_default: I'd like to lower my monthly bill to stay.

rights.claim: Long-term customers often pay a 'loyalty penalty' — new-customer rates are the anchor to ask for.
rights.basis: Regulator findings on loyalty penalties (e.g. UK CMA super-complaint on loyalty pricing).

rights.claim: Retention desks hold discounts that front-line agents cannot offer.
Always get the new rate and how long it is locked, in writing.
rights.basis: Evidentiary best practice for enforcing the agreed price.

ladder: Ask for the loyalty / retention department
Cite a competitor price and be ready to switch
Confirm the new rate + duration in writing

artifact.body:
CALL / CHAT SCRIPT — {{target}} retention

Opening:
"Hi, I've been a customer for a while and my rate has crept up. I'm comparing providers today. {{goal}}"

If offered a small discount:
"I appreciate that — but new customers are paying less than me. Can you connect me to the loyalty / retention team?"

Close:
"Great. Please confirm the new monthly rate and how many months it's locked, in writing to my email."

Notes: stay friendly, be ready to name a competitor price, and be willing to schedule a callback.

— {{name}}

disclaimer: This is information to help you prepare your own call. It is not legal advice and guarantees no outcome.
